title: Strength recovery after ACL injury
author: Rudra Prasad  R.
desc:
Kindly avoid working out if your ACL recovery is below 60-70 percent 


This program I'm following nowadays to recover my strength after an ACL injury ( Grade 1 ) , within 2-4 weeks I regained my previous weight and strength and also training my legs at a safe way to prevent any unnecessary strain on it. 

The maximum amount of time it requires is 120mins / 2 hour ( including rest)

Note :- Kindly use 7mm knee sleeves for every single workout as you suffered from an ACL injury and this program is totally built on personal feedback

ex.note: KEEP THE KNEES ABOUT 90° OR DO PARTIAL REPS AND DON'T LET YOUR KNEES GO PAST THE TOES
MAINTAIN A NEUTRAL LOWER BACK AND HIPS BACK ,  DON'T ALLOW YOUR SPINE TO ROUND
PLACE FOOT ON LOWER HALF OF PLATFORM AND BEND KNEES TO 90°AND TOES OUT SLIGHTLY
FOCUS ON SQUEEZING THE HAMSTRING TO MOVE WEIGHT AND CONTROL THE ECCENTRIC
KEEP YOUR FEETS SHOULDER WIDTH AND SHIN VERTICAL, 2 SEC UP -›1 SEC SQUEEZE -› 2 SEC DOWN

ss.note:
SQUEEZE YOUR CALVES AT TOP AND STRECH AT DOWN 	.	
		Perform on either a smith machine or power squat machine
CONTROL THE ECCENTRIC  , MAINTAIN A NEUTRAL SPINE OR SLIGHTLY BENT AND USE ABDOMINAL FOR MOVEMENT

ex.note: RETRACT AND DEPRESS YOUR SHOULDER , MAINTAIN AN ARC AND ALLOW THE BAR TO TOUCH YOUR CHEST
KEEP YOUR SHOULDERS TUCKED AT 45° AND KEEP INCLINE BENCH AT AN AGLE OF 30°-45°
KEEP YOUR SCAPULA RETRACTED , CHEST UP AND CONTROL THE ECCENTRIC

ss.note: FOCUS ON SQUEEZING AND CONTROL THE ECCENTRIC AND DON'T LIFT YOUR SHOULDERS
MAINTAIN A SLIGHTLY FORWAD LEAN AND ELBOWS TUCKED IN AND USE A PRONATED GRIP

ex.note: MAINTAIN A SLIGHTLY FORWAD LEAN AND KEEP YOUR SHOULDERS TUCKED IN AND STRAIGHTEN YOUR ARM TO THE BOTTOM
KEEP A WIDE NEUTRAL GRIP TO EMPHASIS MORE LATS , MAINTAIN AN ARC AND AVOID SWINGING AND CONTROL ECCENTRIC
RETRACT YOUR SCAPULA DURING THE CONCENTRIC AND PROTRACT YOUR SCAPULA DURING THE ECCENTRIC
USE A V GRIP AND KEEP YOUR ELBOWS TUCKED  AND  PROTRACT YOUR SCAPULA DURING THE ECCENTRIC
PULL YOUR ELBOWS AGAINST YOUR SIDES AND DON'T LET YOUR HAND GO PAST YOUR MIDDLE BODY
SET THE CABLE AT CHEST/EYE HEIGHT AND KEEP YOUR SHOULDERS DOWN AND PROTRACT YOUR SCAPULA DURING THE ECCENTRIC
SET THE INCLINE BENCH AT 45°-60° AND KEEP YOUR ELBOWS STABLE
KEEP YOUR ELBOWS STABLE AND USED A FIXED BARBELL OR NORMAL BARBELL AND CONTROL THE ECCENTRIC
LEAN SLIGHTLY FORWAD FOR BETTER ENGAGEMENT OF TRAPS
BRING THE DUMBBELL ALL THE WAY TO DOWN AND KEEP YOUR TORSO UPRIGHT
LEAN-IN FOR TENSION AT BOTTOM AND DON'T JERK WHILE LIFTING AND CONTROL THE ECCENTRIC (3 SETS ON BOTH HAND)

ex.n: Single Arm Rear Delt Cable Fly
ex.note: BRACE YOUR OTHER HAND AND POINT CHEST OUTWARD TO THE MACHINE AND CONTROL THE ECCENTRIC ( 3 SETS ON BOTH HAND)
KEEP YOUR ARMS AT 15°-30° TOWARDS YOUR HEAD AND LOWER THE EZ BARBELL SLIGHTLY BEHIND THE HEAD AND ELBOWS TUCKED
LEAN FORWARD 10°-15° AND KEEP YOUR ELBOWS STABLE AND DON'T LET SHOULDERS TO LIFT
LEAN SLIGHTLY FORWAD FOR BETTER ENGAGEMENT OF TRAPS
RETRACT AND DEPRESS YOUR SHOULDER , MAINTAIN AN ARC AND ALLOW THE BAR TO TOUCH YOUR CHEST AND TUCK ELBOW AT 45°-75°
TUCK YOUR ELBOWS AT 45°ANGLE, LEAN YOUR TORSO FORWARD 15°
TUCKED AT 45° AND CONTROL THE ECCENTRIC AND BRING THE DUMBBELL DOWN TO THE PECS AND DON'T CLINK THE DUMBBELLS
KEEP YOUR SCAPULA RETRACTED AND DEPRESSED
DO IT SEATED , SET UP THE CABLE AT CHEST HEIGHT OR SLIGHTLY BELOW AND KEEP YOUR BACK STABLE AND FOCUS ON BRINGING BICEPS TOGETHER
